# Velair 1.9.3-beta.1

This beta restores scheduling when climate capabilities arrive late during Home Assistant startup and adds optional tools for reviewing Velair sensor entity IDs.

## ✨ Added

- Following [Home Assistant 2026.11’s naming changes](https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2026/11/03/naming-things-in-home-assistant/), **Settings > Maintenance** lets you review and rename selected sensor IDs to better distinguish climates with the same name. Thanks to @overas for the follow-up in [#87](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/87#issuecomment-6850162906).
- Translate the new sensor ID review controls and refresh the affected usage, sensor and troubleshooting guides in all nine supported non-English languages.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Recover scheduled events when a climate device publishes its HVAC modes or target capabilities after Home Assistant startup. The existing startup setting controls applying the already active block; future events recover with either setting. Diagnostics distinguishes waiting capabilities from incompatible schedules. Thanks to @dminar for reporting [#90](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/90).
- Give newly registered per-climate sensors descriptive initial entity IDs based on their source climate and purpose, including when several thermostats share a name. Existing sensor IDs and customized names remain unchanged unless you explicitly select IDs to rename. Follow-up to [#87](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/87#issuecomment-6850162906), reported by @overas.

## 🧭 Notes

- This is a prerelease for testing. After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
- Sensor ID review is optional and starts with no IDs selected. Renaming an ID may require updating references in automations, dashboards and templates; automatic reference updates are not guaranteed.
- Test startup recovery with your usual schedules and devices. Real Home Assistant Core tests cover delayed capabilities with both startup settings, and the maintainer confirmed the correction in their own installation; other device-specific startup sequences may differ.
- Updated translations were checked for source alignment and remain marked as automatic pending human linguistic review.
